inputs.CREATION_REQUEST: Create a difficult production-grade Ansible operational recovery task. The inherited automation should fail through a realistic chain of interacting issues rather than disclosed one-step fixes. Solver-visible evidence should include execution logs and legitimate operational artifacts that force diagnosis by running Ansible and reading failures. The task must include an outdated Ansible installation whose consequences surface through multiple behaviors, including inability to generate the intended initial project configuration with the supported init workflow; do not directly tell the solver the version is the cause or explicitly instruct them to upgrade. Include project-local role discovery/path problems, undefined and incorrectly scoped variables, vaulted-secret handling defects, incorrect role invocation/order/dependency behavior, difficult YAML/Ansible syntax faults, and non-trivial Jinja2/template logic failures with downstream behavioral effects. The starter must be a coherent production-style automation estate with substantive differentiated roles, inventories, vars, templates, handlers, validation, idempotency, and operational workflows, not duplicated filler. Provide solver-visible references to official Ansible documentation as helper material; documentation content or citations must be sourced from official Ansible documentation rather than AI-authored substitutes. Instructions should describe the required operational end state and evidence/log locations without naming the hidden repair topology. The solver must execute the playbooks, inspect logs/results, and troubleshoot to a convergent, secure, idempotent final state.
inputs.REQUESTED_DOMAIN: Ansible production automation, configuration-management reliability, role architecture, variable precedence, Vault, Jinja2 templating, project configuration, and incident-driven fleet recovery
inputs.NETWORK_ENVIRONMENT_CONSTRAINTS: Task runtime should remain deterministic and self-contained. Official Ansible documentation may be referenced and/or captured from docs.ansible.com during task authoring, but solver correctness must not depend on mutable external network access at grading time.
